name: Sumadhura Epitome
address: Railway Parallel Road, Rachenahalli, Thanisandra, Bengaluru, Karnataka
description: Sumadhura Epitome is a three-tower apartment community in Rachenahalli, shaped by Mediterranean-inspired architecture and all-corner home planning. The developer describes 262 residences across 3.75 acres, with landscaped outdoor areas and a clubhouse anchoring the recreation offering. Arched architectural details, courtyard-inspired spaces and homes described as having no shared walls give the project a recognisable character.

content.faqsTitle: Six things to know about Sumadhura Epitome

faqs.question: Where exactly is Sumadhura Epitome located?
faqs.answer: Railway Parallel Road, Rachenahalli, Thanisandra, Bengaluru, Karnataka, 560064. The Google Maps link uses this project and address.

faqs.question: What configurations and sizes are documented?
faqs.answer: 2 BHK, 3 BHK, 4 BHK. Documented saleable/super built-up plan areas span 1290–2120 sq ft. The layout table identifies each area basis and applicable phase.

faqs.question: What is the published starting price?
faqs.answer: ₹1.67 Cr–₹2.3 Cr* Onward. The pricing record identifies the source and quoted configuration. Unpriced formats are excluded from the reference range; a current cost sheet is needed for the selected unit. Applicable charges are itemised separately by the source.

faqs.question: What is the status and possession timeline?
faqs.answer: Under construction. Published timeline: December 2027. This is a published schedule/status reference, not a fresh contractual handover confirmation.

faqs.question: What are the main amenities?
faqs.answer: Swimming Pool, Kids Play Area, Jogging Track, Garden, Multi Purpose Court, Senior Citizen Area. 50 amenities in current developer copy. These are published facilities; confirm which are completed and accessible to your selected phase.

faqs.question: What makes this project worth comparing?
faqs.answer: 3.75 acres with 262 residences and three towers All corner home planning described by the developer No shared walls described by the developer. Aaramv can compare these features with your space needs, budget and daily routes, and help coordinate the next steps through move-in.
